Usage: ocfl stage add <path> [flags]

Add a file or directory to the stage

Arguments:
  <path>    file or parent directory for content to add to the stage

Flags:
  -h, --help                      Show context-sensitive help.
      --root=STRING               The prefix/directory of the OCFL storage root
                                  used for the command ($OCFL_ROOT)
      --debug                     enable debug log messages

  -f, --file="ocfl-stage.json"    path to stage file
      --no-hidden                 exclude hidden files and directories (.*).
                                  Ignored if path is a file.
      --as=STRING                 logical name for the new content. Default:
                                  base name if path is a file; '.' if path is a
                                  directory.
  -j, --jobs=0                    number of files to digest concurrently.
                                  Defaults to the number of CPU cores.
      --remove                    also remove staged files not found in the
                                  path. Ignored if path is a file.
